Name: Rock Hunt
Author: sexynes
Description:
Recommended: 
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7415]Character customization anywhere[/url]﻿ to alternate between debris 
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4715]Reset Terrain Features[/url]﻿ to respawn terrain features (might be outdated) 
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2213]Unlimited Players[/url]﻿ (might be outdated) 
[*]Use the lightest coloring when customizing 
[*]Play on a new farm to hide among other debris 
[/list]
Issues: 
[list]
[*]Changing eye color in the character customization menu may result in a rectangular-looking figure. To fix this issue, simply change to another shirt in the same menu. 
[*]Wearing a hat may cause the subject to vanish. 
[/list]
Suggested Rules: 
[list]
[*]Must be conspicuous while hiding  
[*]Can not use map, social tab, or other advantages while as seeker 
[*]Everyone has the same viewing distance 
[*]Do not expose other known subjects unless requested 
[*]If not found after 4 in-game hours, players must change subject/location when safe to do so 
[*]Last subject yet to be found may state a hint 
[/list]
Other Hunts: [list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9893]Prop Hunt[/url]﻿ 
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10075]Crop Hunt[/url]﻿ 
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10242/]Pot Hunt[/url]﻿ 
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10259/]Walk Hunt[/url]﻿ 
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10269/]Paw Hunt[/url]﻿ 
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10389]Log Hunt[/url]﻿ 
[/list]
